title: Ionization and Dissociation Energies of Molecular Hydrogen
abstract: Molecular hydrogen (H$_2$) is the simplest neutral molecule and its ionization and dissociation energies are key benchmarks for testing first-principles calculations of nonadiabatic, relativistic, quantum-electrodynamic and finite-nuclear-size effects in molecules. To obtain improved H$_2$ ionization and dissociation energies, we performed precision measurements of 15 transition frequencies in para-H$_2$. They connect the X $^1\Sigma_g^+(v=0,N=0)$ ground state, the long-lived EF $^1\Sigma_g^+(v=0,N=0)$ excited state, and several high members of the $n$p and $n$d Rydberg series with principal quantum number $n$ in the range between 48 and 70. The new data by itself leads to a five times more accurate value of the ionization energy of the ground state of para-H$_2$, equivalent to a relative frequency accuracy of $5\times 10^{-11}$. Combined with a global network analysis of 45 energy intervals in para- and ortho-H$_2$ that have been measured in the past three decades, we obtain new statistically robust values for the ionization energy [$E_{\rm I}(0,0)/(hc)= 124\,417.491\,1573(58)$~cm$^{-1}$] and the dissociation energy [$D_0^{N=0}=36\,118.069\,6646(58)$~cm$^{-1}$] of H$_2$. These values have an unprecedented accuracy equivalent to 175 kHz. The network analysis also leads to improved term values and dissociation energies of the excited states involved in the analysis. By comparing the results with first-principles calculations of the level structures of H$_2$ and H$_2^+$ , a significantly reduced upper bound of 540 kHz is derived for putative beyond-the-standard-model contributions to the energy difference between para- and ortho-H$_2$.

summaries.en: Precision measurements of 15 transitions in para-H2, combined with a global network analysis of 45 energy intervals, yield ionization and dissociation energies of H2 with an unprecedented accuracy equivalent to 175 kHz and set a reduced 540 kHz upper bound on beyond-standard-model contributions to the para-ortho energy difference.
summaries.zh: 通过对仲氢15个跃迁的精密测量并结合对45个能量间隔的整体网络分析，获得了精度达到175 kHz的氢分子电离能和离解能，并将仲氢与正氢能量差中超出标准模型贡献的上限降至540 kHz。
summaries.ja: パラ水素の15遷移の精密測定と45のエネルギー間隔の大域的ネットワーク解析により、175 kHzに相当する前例のない精度で水素分子のイオン化エネルギーと解離エネルギーが得られ、パラ・オルト水素間のエネルギー差に対する標準模型を超える寄与の上限が540 kHzに低減された。

title: Characterizing Reaction Types through Linear Free-Energy Relationships in Cavities
abstract: Polaritonic chemistry holds the promise of controlling chemical reactivity through confined light-matter interactions, yet how reactions respond inside optical cavities remains debated. Here, we take a more zoomed-out view, inspired by electrostatic catalysis. We extend nonempirical linear free-energy relationships to cavity-modified reactions and show that their behavior falls into four distinct reaction types set by simple response-crossing rules. Reactions can follow conventional Bell-Evans-Polanyi (BEP) or counterintuitive Opposite-BEP behavior regardless of cavity tuning, or switch between the two as the cavity frequency is varied. We establish this picture analytically and demonstrate it in the Shin Metiu model and in four molecular reactions treated with ab initio electronic-structure methods. Even at this deliberately coarse-grained level, cavity-modified reactivity already shows qualitatively different and strongly counterintuitive behavior, including reactions that switch character with cavity frequency. Yet this complexity can still be reduced to a simple competition between permanent-dipole and polarizability responses. This reaction-type classification therefore provides a new route to organize and anticipate cavity-modified reactivity.

summaries.en: By extending nonempirical linear free-energy relationships to cavity-modified reactions, the authors show that polaritonic reactivity falls into four distinct types governed by response-crossing rules, reflecting a simple competition between permanent-dipole and polarizability responses.
summaries.zh: 通过将非经验性线性自由能关系推广至腔修饰反应，作者表明极化激元反应活性可分为由响应交叉规则决定的四种不同类型，反映了永久偶极与极化率响应之间的简单竞争。
summaries.ja: 非経験的線形自由エネルギー関係をキャビティ修飾反応に拡張することで、著者らはポラリトン反応性が応答交差則に支配される四つの異なるタイプに分類され、永久双極子応答と分極率応答の単純な競合を反映することを示した。

title: Photon Statistics and Light Squeezing Under Vibrational Strong Coupling from Real-Time Nuclear--Electronic Orbital Theory
abstract: Molecular polaritons have attracted great interest in recent years as a promising avenue for developing optical control of chemical processes. A major open question in this field is the role of quantum optical effects in understanding the molecular dynamics observed in cavities. In this work, we use our recently developed mean-field quantum and full-quantum real-time nuclear--electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory methods to simulate photon statistics for a cavity mode strongly coupled to a molecular vibrational transition. Our comparative use of these two methods allows us to isolate the contributions of light--matter entanglement to the photon statistics. We consider three initial conditions of the cavity mode: a coherent state, a squeezed coherent state, and a single photon Fock state. These conditions span Poissonian, super-Poissonian, and sub-Poissonian photon statistics. Our full-quantum dynamics initialized with a coherent state show considerable super-Poissonian fluctuations of the photon statistics and light-squeezing of the cavity photons by the vibrational mode. These dynamics are particularly notable considering the quasi-classical properties of the coherent state. The squeezed coherent and Fock state initial conditions also demonstrate noteworthy fluctuations in the photon statistics. All three initial conditions reveal dynamics in the full-quantum photon statistics that differ considerably from the statistics obtained with the mean-field quantum method. Our results demonstrate the importance of considering quantum optical effects for molecules under strong coupling in certain situations.

summaries.en: Using mean-field quantum and full-quantum real-time nuclear–electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory to simulate a cavity mode strongly coupled to a molecular vibration, the authors show that light–matter entanglement produces super-Poissonian photon fluctuations and cavity light squeezing from a coherent state, with photon statistics that differ considerably between the full-quantum and mean-field treatments across coherent, squeezed coherent, and Fock initial states.
summaries.zh: 作者利用平均场量子与全量子实时核-电子轨道含时密度泛函理论方法模拟与分子振动强耦合的腔模，发现光-物质纠缠会使相干态产生显著的超泊松光子涨落和腔光压缩，且对于相干态、压缩相干态和单光子福克态三种初始条件，全量子与平均场方法得到的光子统计存在显著差异。
summaries.ja: 平均場量子論と全量子リアルタイム核–電子軌道時間依存密度汎関数理論を用いて分子振動と強結合したキャビティモードをシミュレーションした結果、光–物質もつれがコヒーレント状態から超ポアソン的な光子ゆらぎとキャビティ光のスクイージングを生み出し、コヒーレント状態・スクイーズドコヒーレント状態・フォック状態のいずれの初期条件でも全量子法と平均場法の光子統計は大きく異なることが示された。

title: Nonlinear Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons at van der Waals topological interfaces
abstract: Topological photonic structures provide a powerful means of confining and directing light through interface states formed between photonic phases with distinct topological properties. Van der Waals (vdW) materials offer complementary opportunities for nanophotonics: their optical properties can be selected from a wide family of layered crystals, while their atomically smooth surfaces and lack of lattice-matching constraints enable complex photonic heterostructures to be assembled layer by layer. This flexibility allows topological photonic confinement and strong excitonic coupling to be engineered separately within the same structure. Here, patterned low-loss dielectric hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) defines the photonic modes, while an encapsulated WSe2 monolayer provides the excitonic resonance that couples directly to the confined optical field. We use this approach to realise Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons in a one-dimensional hBN double-grating heterostructure. Strong coupling between the WSe2 exciton and a photonic Jackiw-Rebbi state localised at the interface between two topologically distinct gratings produces upper and lower Jackiw-Rebbi polariton branches. By varying the temperature from 4.7 to 300 K, we tune the exciton across the photonic bandgap and trace the evolution and anticrossing of these branches using angle-resolved reflectance and photoluminescence spectroscopy. Power-dependent photoluminescence further reveals a pronounced nonlinear response of the confined Jackiw-Rebbi polariton, including a blueshift of up to 5 meV and correlated changes in its intensity scaling and linewidth. These results establish vdW photonic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering tunable and nonlinear polaritons localised at topological interfaces.

summaries.en: The paper realizes Jackiw-Rebbi exciton-polaritons by strongly coupling a WSe2 exciton to a topological interface state in a one-dimensional hBN double-grating heterostructure, and demonstrates tuning of the polariton branches with temperature as well as a pronounced nonlinear response with a blueshift of up to 5 meV.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过将WSe2激子与一维hBN双光栅异质结构中局域于拓扑界面的Jackiw-Rebbi光子态强耦合，实现了Jackiw-Rebbi激子极化激元，并展示了随温度调控的极化激元支演化以及高达5 meV蓝移的显著非线性响应。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、一次元hBN二重グレーティングヘテロ構造においてWSe2励起子とトポロジカル界面に局在するJackiw-Rebbi光子状態を強結合させることでJackiw-Rebbi励起子ポラリトンを実現し、温度による分岐の制御と最大5 meVのブルーシフトを含む顕著な非線形応答を示した。

title: On the gauge-invariant orbital angular momentum of vector optical vortices in the paraxial approximation and beyond
abstract: In this paper we present a gauge-invariant formalism for describing the spin and orbital angular momenta of scalar and vector optical vortices. The correction term, arising from consistent incorporation of the transverse vector potential's nonlocality, restores gauge invariance and makes it possible to separate the total angular momentum into spin and orbital components. We propose a method for calculating the orbital and spin angular momenta of multimode vector vortex fields and show that the orbital angular momentum of such beams contains two qualitatively different components. The polarization-independent contribution to the orbital angular momentum is related to the topological charge that determines the order of the phase singularity, while the polarization-dependent one is proportional to the helical topological charge that determines the spatial inhomogeneity of the polarization. We also discuss the quantization procedure for fields with spatially inhomogeneous polarization in terms of modes with a helical topological charge, and examine the limits of applicability of the proposed formalism.

summaries.en: The paper presents a gauge-invariant formalism for separating the spin and orbital angular momenta of scalar and vector optical vortices, showing that the orbital angular momentum of multimode vector vortex fields has a polarization-independent component tied to the phase singularity's topological charge and a polarization-dependent component proportional to the helical topological charge governing polarization inhomogeneity.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种规范不变的形式体系，用于分离标量和矢量光学涡旋的自旋角动量与轨道角动量，并表明多模矢量涡旋场的轨道角动量包含与决定相位奇点阶数的拓扑荷相关的偏振无关分量以及与决定偏振空间不均匀性的螺旋拓扑荷成正比的偏振相关分量。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、スカラーおよびベクトル光学渦のスピン角運動量と軌道角運動量を分離するためのゲージ不変な定式化を提示し、マルチモードベクトル渦場の軌道角運動量が、位相特異点の次数を決めるトポロジカルチャージに依存する偏光非依存成分と、偏光の空間的不均一性を決める螺旋トポロジカルチャージに比例する偏光依存成分を含むことを示した。

title: Fundamental limits on photonic state preparation from phase-space majorization
abstract: Preparing complex quantum states of light for quantum information processing tasks often proceeds by converting from simpler states via experimentally accessible operations. We provide fundamental bounds on such probabilistic conversions, both exact and approximate. To do so, we establish a theory of weak, fully relative majorization that compares the disorder of phase-space functions. Our framework is versatile and can be tailored to different systems and sets of allowed operations. Focusing on Wigner functions in multimode photonic systems, we establish rigorous no-go results and tradeoff relations for exact and approximate conversions involving squeezed states, cat states, Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill states, and Fock states. In doing so, we derive novel bounds and recover known tight ones. Our results demonstrate that phase-space disorder imposes strong limitations on photonic state preparation.

summaries.en: By developing a theory of weak, fully relative majorization that compares the disorder of phase-space functions, the authors derive fundamental exact and approximate bounds on probabilistic photonic state conversions, yielding no-go results and tradeoff relations for squeezed, cat, Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill, and Fock states that show phase-space disorder strongly limits state preparation.
summaries.zh: 作者通过建立一种比较相空间函数无序度的弱完全相对主化理论，推导出光子态概率转换的基本精确界与近似界，并针对压缩态、猫态、Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill态和Fock态给出严格的不可行结果与权衡关系，表明相空间无序度对光子态制备构成强烈限制。
summaries.ja: 著者らは、相空間関数の無秩序度を比較する弱い完全相対マジョリゼーション理論を構築することで、光子状態の確率的変換に対する基本的な厳密界と近似界を導出し、スクイーズド状態・猫状態・Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill状態・Fock状態について厳密な不可能性結果とトレードオフ関係を示して、相空間の無秩序度が光子状態準備を強く制限することを明らかにした。

title: A Coherent Neutron-Nucleus Hybrid System Mediated by the Strong Interaction
abstract: A coherent ensemble of polarized helium-3 nuclei and free neutrons are coupled, forming a neutron-nucleus hybrid system. The nuclei are prepared in a spin superposition, while a magnetic field induces Zeeman splitting. The resulting nuclear energy phase is coherently transferred to the neutron, producing an intensity beat at the nuclear Zeeman frequency. Finally, the incident neutron is prepared in a spin-energy superposition state. The nuclear and neutron phases then heterodyne coherently, producing a signal at the sum or difference frequency depending on their relative helicity.

summaries.en: Polarized helium-3 nuclei and free neutrons form a coherent hybrid system in which the nuclear Zeeman energy phase is coherently transferred to a spin-energy superposition of the neutron, producing intensity beats and heterodyne signals at the sum or difference frequency depending on their relative helicity.
summaries.zh: 极化氦-3原子核与自由中子耦合形成相干的杂化体系，核塞曼能量相位被相干转移到中子的自旋-能量叠加态，从而产生强度拍频，并依据相对螺旋度在和频或差频处产生外差信号。
summaries.ja: 偏極ヘリウム3原子核と自由中性子が結合してコヒーレントなハイブリッド系を形成し、核ゼーマンエネルギー位相が中性子のスピン・エネルギー重ね合わせ状態へコヒーレントに転送されることで強度ビートが生じ、相対ヘリシティに応じて和周波数または差周波数でヘテロダイン信号が発生する。

title: Active Approach to Fast Quantum State Preparation and Reset in Atomic Arrays
abstract: Rapid preparation of a target quantum state and reset to the many-body ground state are essential for quantum information processing. Here, we investigate both processes in a waveguide-coupled emitter array in the low-excitation regime. By decomposing the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian into biorthogonal eigenmodes, we show that relaxation depends on the initial overlap with the more subradiant modes, providing a modal explanation of the Mpemba effect. Guided by this insight, we design a reset protocol in which a finite-duration local drive activelysuppresses the relatively slow-decaying components. For the parameters studied, this reduces the time to reach a fixed residual-excitation threshold by up to approximately 25% compared with free decay. To prepare a target Dicke state, we introduce a two-step protocol that initially leaves one emitter undriven before restoring the full drive that stabilizes the target. This local control redistributes spectral weight into the more subradiant modes, driving them closer to their target amplitudes, which reduces the preparation time by up to approximately 45% while consuming less driving energy than continuous driving. Finally, we show how directional waveguide coupling shifts collective modes toward a preferred boundary through the non-Hermitian skin effect, providing guidance for selecting the preferred site for local operations. We term this fundamental dependence of the relaxation dynamics on the system's chirality the ``non-Hermitian Skin-Mpemba effect.'' These results demonstrate how selective local control can accelerate state preparation and reset in open quantum systems.

summaries.en: By decomposing the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian of a waveguide-coupled emitter array into biorthogonal eigenmodes, this work explains the Mpemba effect through overlaps with subradiant modes and shows that selective local driving can speed up ground-state reset by up to about 25% and Dicke-state preparation by up to about 45% while using less driving energy, with directional coupling inducing a non-Hermitian Skin-Mpemba effect that guides site selection for local control.
summaries.zh: 该工作通过将波导耦合发射器阵列的有效非厄米哈密顿量分解为双正交本征模，以与亚辐射模的重叠解释了姆潘巴效应，并表明选择性局域驱动可将基态重置时间最多缩短约25%、将迪克态制备时间最多缩短约45%且消耗更少驱动能量，同时方向性耦合会引发非厄米趋肤-姆潘巴效应，为局域操控的位点选择提供指导。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、導波路結合エミッタアレイの有効非エルミートハミルトニアンを双直交固有モードに分解することで、亜放射モードとの重なりに基づく Mpemba 効果の説明を与え、選択的局所駆動により基底状態リセット時間を最大約25%、Dicke 状態準備時間を最大約45%短縮しつつ駆動エネルギーを削減できることを示すとともに、方向性結合が非エルミート Skin-Mpemba 効果を引き起こし局所操作のサイト選択を導くことを明らかにした。

title: Maximally-Matched Mixture Decoding for Correlated Atom Loss in Quantum LDPC Codes
abstract: Heralded atom loss is a dominant noise channel in neutral atom quantum computing platforms, and losses at a two-qubit gate are strongly correlated: when one atom is lost, its gate partner is often lost too. This work shows how to exploit this correlation to construct a better decoder, focusing on [[144,12,12]] Gross code syndrome extraction circuits. Given a loss readout, the possible pairings of the lost qubits according to shared gates form a graph whose maximum matchings carry almost all of the conditional probability mass. Our maximal-matching-mixture (MMM) decoder builds a per-readout decoding hypergraph as a weighted mixture over exactly these loss scenarios. This decoding hypergraph can be used by an ordinary belief-propagation decoder. On the [[144,12,12]] Gross code, MMM lowers the logical error rate by as much as ~25x relative to a loss-unaware decoder and ~2x relative to a loss-aware uniform-mixture baseline from Baranes et al. (2026).

summaries.en: Exploiting the strong correlation between atom losses at two-qubit gates, the maximal-matching-mixture decoder builds a per-readout decoding hypergraph as a weighted mixture over maximum matchings of the lost-qubit pairing graph, lowering the logical error rate of the [[144,12,12]] Gross code by up to ~25x versus a loss-unaware decoder and ~2x versus a uniform-mixture baseline.
summaries.zh: 该方法利用双量子比特门上原子丢失之间的强相关性，以丢失量子比特配对图的最大匹配为核心构建逐读出解码超图，使[[144,12,12]] Gross码的逻辑错误率相比不感知丢失的解码器最多降低约25倍，相比均匀混合基线降低约2倍。
summaries.ja: 二量子ビットゲートでの原子損失が強く相関することを利用し、失われた量子ビットのペアリンググラフの最大マッチング上の重み付き混合として読み出しごとの復号ハイパーグラフを構築するこの手法は、[[144,12,12]] Gross符号の論理エラー率を損失非考慮の復号器に比べて最大約25倍、一様混合ベースラインに比べて約2倍低減する。

title: Hyperentanglement-enabled Quantum Privacy Amplification for Classical-Quantum Coexistence in Fiber Networks
abstract: Integrating quantum communication into existing fiber infrastructures requires coexisting with high-power classical traffic, which generates noise in the quantum channel. Spontaneous Raman Scattering (SpRS) is the dominant noise source, generating a broadband photon background that degrades quantum states and, in Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), can entirely suppress secure key generation. In this work, we implement single-copy entanglement distillation utilizing energy-time and frequency hyperentanglement, and we exploit it to perform Quantum Privacy Amplification (QPA) directly at a physical layer. Strict frequency anti-correlations of spontaneous parametric down-conversion are used to selectively discard uncorrelated Raman photons while preserving genuine entangled pairs, suppressing accidental coincidences by a factor $1/N$, where $N$ is the number of frequency channel pairs. Using passive borosilicate-glass photonic integrated circuits and standard DWDM demultiplexers over a 20~km single-mode fiber testbed, we demonstrate a 4~dB improvement in tolerance to classical laser launch power $P_C$ when QPA is performed, extending the secure key threshold from $P_C=-13.3$ dBm to $P_C=-9.3$ dBm. The result shows that off-the-shelf telecom components can be repurposed as physical-layer quantum privacy amplifiers.

summaries.en: Using energy-time and frequency hyperentanglement for single-copy entanglement distillation, this work demonstrates physical-layer quantum privacy amplification that suppresses Raman noise by a factor 1/N and, employing passive borosilicate-glass photonic integrated circuits and DWDM demultiplexers over 20 km of single-mode fiber, improves classical laser launch power tolerance by 4 dB, extending the secure key threshold from -13.
summaries.zh: 本工作利用能量-时间与频率超纠缠实现单拷贝纠缠蒸馏，在物理层进行量子隐私放大，凭借1/N因子抑制拉曼噪声，并在20公里单模光纤上采用无源硼硅玻璃光子集成电路与DWDM解复用器，使经典激光发射功率容限提升4 dB，将安全密钥阈值从-13.
summaries.ja: 本研究はエネルギー時間・周波数ハイパーエンタングルメントを用いた単一コピー entanglement distillation により物理層で量子プライバシー増幅を実現し、ラマン雑音を1/Nに抑え、20 km単模ファイバ上で受動ホウケイ酸ガラス光集積回路とDWDM分波器を用いて、古典レーザー投入電力の許容度を4 dB改善し、安全鍵閾値を-13.

title: Goldbach Representations in Quantum Optics and Metrology
abstract: We derive a relation between Goldbach representations and photon-number statistics in a quantum-optical setup. Considering an even-number Fock state injected into a stochastic beam splitter with uniformly distributed transmissivity and projections of the two output modes onto prime subspaces, we demonstrate that each successful outcome corresponds to an Goldbach representation and that the averaged detection probability is exactly proportional to the number of Goldbach representations. Then, employing the Hardy--Littlewood asymptotic formula, we demonstrate that the post-measurement state generated by a beam splitter with fixed transmissivity exhibits standard quantum limit scaling of the ultimate precision limit in terms of phase estimation, whereas an equally weighted superposition of Goldbach representations exhibits Heisenberg scaling. These results provide a quantum-optical realization of Goldbach representations and relate their statistics of with quantum metrology.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mathematical Physics (math-ph); Number Theory (math.NT)

summaries.en: By injecting an even-number Fock state into a stochastic beam splitter and projecting the two output modes onto prime subspaces, each successful outcome realizes a Goldbach representation whose averaged detection probability is exactly proportional to the number of Goldbach representations, with fixed-transmissivity post-measurement states showing standard quantum limit phase-estimation scaling while an equally weighted superposition of Goldbach representations achieves Heisenberg scaling.
summaries.zh: 通过将偶数光子数的Fock态注入透射率均匀分布的随机分束器，并将两个输出模投影到素数子空间，每个成功结果都对应一个哥德巴赫表示，且平均探测概率恰好正比于哥德巴赫表示的数量；基于Hardy-Littlewood渐近公式，固定透射率分束器产生的测量后态在相位估计中呈现标准量子极限标度，而哥德巴赫表示的等权叠加则呈现海森堡标度。
summaries.ja: 偶数光子数のフォック状態を一様分布の透過率を持つ確率的ビームスプリッターに入射し、二つの出力モードを素数の部分空間へ射影すると、各成功結果はゴールドバッハ表現に対応し、平均検出確率はゴールドバッハ表現の数に正確に比例し、固定透過率のビームスプリッターで生成される測定後状態は位相推定において標準量子限界のスケーリングを示す一方、ゴールドバッハ表現の等重み重ね合わせはハイゼンベルクスケーリングを示す。

title: Key Evaluation of a Relativistic Quantum Key Distribution Over a Turbulent Free-space Optical Channel
abstract: We investigate the performance of relativistic quantum key distribution (RQKD) over turbulent free-space optical channels for both single-photon and coherent-state implementations. A theoretical model is developed to describe the effect of atmospheric turbulence on interferometric visibility and secret-key generation by incorporating turbulence-induced phase fluctuations into the key-rate analysis. Numerical simulations are performed under realistic channel conditions to evaluate the achievable communication distance and secret-key rate. The results show that atmospheric turbulence degrades the protocol performance by reducing interference visibility, with the severity of the degradation determined by the ratio between the interferometer-arm separation $r$ (or temporal separation of signal and reference states $\Delta T$) and Fried's parameter. The single-photon protocol remains operational over all investigated turbulence regimes, whereas the coherent-state implementation exhibits a critical dependence on the interferometer geometry (especially on $\Delta T$), leading to a threshold beyond which secure key generation is no longer possible. These findings quantify the impact of atmospheric turbulence on relativistic quantum key distribution and provide practical guidelines for the design and optimization of free-space RQKD systems.

summaries.en: This paper models how atmospheric turbulence degrades the interference visibility and secret-key rate of relativistic quantum key distribution over free-space optical links, showing that the single-photon protocol remains operational across all investigated turbulence regimes while the coherent-state implementation has a geometry-dependent threshold beyond which secure key generation becomes impossible.
summaries.zh: 本文建立了将湍流引起的相位涨落纳入密钥率分析的理论模型，研究了大气湍流对自由空间相对论量子密钥分发干涉可见度和密钥生成的影响，结果表明单光子协议在所有研究的湍流条件下均可运行，而相干态实现则依赖于干涉仪几何结构并存在无法生成安全密钥的阈值。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、大気乱流による位相揺らぎを鍵生成率解析に組み込んだ理論モデルにより、自由空間光リンク上の相対論的量子鍵配送における干渉可視度と鍵生成率の劣化を評価し、単一光子プロトコルは調査したすべての乱流領域で動作可能である一方、コヒーレント状態実装は干渉計の幾何配置に依存し安全な鍵生成が不可能となる閾値が存在することを示した。

title: Gravitational Interactions in Nuclear Clocks
abstract: Atomic clocks achieve extraordinary precision through quantum control over large ensembles of atoms, with precision increasing and atom number advancing steadily. Emerging nuclear clock technology encodes clock states in nuclear rather than electronic transitions, offering a new frontier for precision measurement. Here we study whether a large ensemble of such clock nuclei could be used to observe their mutual gravitational interaction. We investigate the gravitational redshift induced by neighboring atoms, including nuclear energy superpositions as sources of gravity, giving rise to a genuinely quantum gravitational interaction between pairs of nuclei. We find that the resulting clock frequency shift due to mutual gravity may become non-negligible for a macroscopic number of nuclei, for instance in a solid-state thorium clock, and we propose approaches to mitigate electromagnetic field effects by exploiting spatial symmetry and high-precision spectroscopy. We further discuss how energy-induced mass superpositions could be directly probed using external gravitational field sensors. By contrast, observing gravity-induced entanglement involving clocks would require substantially greater experimental advances due to decoherence from spontaneous emission. Taken together, our results suggest that nuclear clocks, either alone or in combination with complementary sensors such as optomechanical systems, may offer a future route toward probing gravity at short distances and testing gravitating quantum source masses beyond the Newtonian limit.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology (gr-qc); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: This paper theoretically investigates whether large ensembles of nuclear clock nuclei, such as solid-state thorium clocks, could exhibit non-negligible gravitational redshift and genuinely quantum gravitational interactions from nuclear energy superpositions, and proposes spatial-symmetry and high-precision spectroscopy methods to mitigate electromagnetic effects while noting that observing gravity-induced entanglement would require far greater experimental advances due to spontaneous-emission decoherence.
summaries.zh: 本文从理论上研究了大型核钟原子核系综（例如固态钍钟）是否会表现出不可忽略的引力红移以及由核能叠加产生的真正量子引力相互作用，并提出利用空间对称性和高精度光谱学来抑制电磁效应，同时指出由于自发辐射退相干，观测引力诱导的纠缠需要远为重大的实验进展。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、固体トリウム時計のような核時計原子核の大規模集団が無視できない重力赤方偏移や核エネルギーの重ね合わせに由来する真に量子的な重力相互作用を示しうるかを理論的に検討し、空間対称性と高精度分光による電磁場効果の抑制法を提案するとともに、自発放出によるデコヒーレンスのため重力誘起エンタングルメントの観測にははるかに大きな実験的進展が必要であると指摘する。

title: Drive-tunable Floquet exchange spectroscopy with Hong--Ou--Mandel interference
abstract: Floquet driving reshapes cavity spectra, but single-photon sideband populations do not reveal how it changes two-photon exchange. Here we show theoretically that delay-resolved Hong--Ou--Mandel (HOM) coincidences can probe this response in a collectively coupled cavity. A frequency-entangled signal photon scatters linearly from the driven cavity while its idler provides a delayed reference. Averaging over an unsynchronized drive phase removes coherence between different net output orders but preserves exchange interference within each order. Fourier transformation of the coincidence trace yields two drive-dependent exchange branches associated with the Floquet-polariton spectrum. As the drive changes, the branches shift and exchange weight; the dominant physical output order also changes, a transfer not reproduced by single-photon sideband populations. We further map the coincidence-trace response over drive frequency and amplitude and connect it to a count-model-dependent Fisher information. Floquet control thus adds a tunable exchange spectrum to HOM interferometry and gives quantitative targets for an experiment.

summaries.en: This theoretical work shows that delay-resolved Hong-Ou-Mandel coincidences from a frequency-entangled photon pair scattering off a collectively coupled Floquet-driven cavity reveal two drive-dependent exchange branches tied to the Floquet-polariton spectrum, whose shifts, weight exchange, and dominant output-order transfer are invisible in single-photon sideband populations and are mapped over drive frequency and amplitude with count-model-dependent Fisher information.
summaries.zh: 这一理论研究表，频率纠缠光子对中信号光从集体耦合的Floquet驱动腔线性散射、闲频光作为延迟参考时，延迟分辨的Hong-Ou-Mandel符合计数会呈现出与Floquet极化激元谱相关的两个驱动依赖的交换分支，这些分支的移动、权重交换以及主导输出阶次的转移无法从单光子边带布居看出，并可在驱动频率和幅度上映射并与依赖计数模型的Fisher信息相联系。
summaries.ja: この理論研究は、周波数もつれ光子対のうちシグナル光子が集団結合したFloquet駆動共振器から線形散乱しアイドラー光子が遅延参照となる遅延分解Hong-Ou-Mandel同時計数が、Floquetポラリトン共鳴に関連する二つの駆動依存の交換分岐を明らかにし、その分岐のシフトや交換重みの移動、支配的な出力次数の移行は単一光子サイドバンド分布では見えず、駆動周波数と振幅にわたり計数モデル依存のFisher情報と結び付けてマッピングされることを示す。

title: High-Threshold Fusion-Based Quantum Computation with Optical Hybrid Qubits
abstract: Hybrid discrete- and continuous-variable (DV-CV) encodings have been developed to overcome operational drawbacks of each individual encoding, while fusion-based quantum computation (FBQC) has emerged to address the practical challenges of scalability toward fault-tolerant photonic quantum computation. Here we introduce hybrid FBQC using small optical DV-CV hybrid resource states connected through hybrid fusions, to combine the advantages of both approaches. We develop protocols for directly generating these resource states without requiring local hybrid logic such as the Hadamard gate, together with a tailored decoding strategy that exploits the error information contained in individual hybrid-fusion outcomes. We demonstrate that hybrid FBQC achieves a photon loss threshold of 2.231% while requiring only 12 hybrid fusions per surface-code unit cell, substantially improving upon the 0.89% threshold and 60-fusion requirement of previous hybrid measurement-based scheme. These results establish optical hybrid FBQC as a high-threshold resource-efficient route to scalable fault-tolerant photonic quantum computation.

summaries.en: Hybrid fusion-based quantum computation using small optical discrete-continuous-variable hybrid resource states and hybrid fusions achieves a photon loss threshold of 2.
summaries.zh: 利用小型光学离散-连续变量混合资源态和混合聚变的高阈值聚变型量子计算实现了2.
summaries.ja: 小型の光学的離散・連続変数ハイブリッドリソース状態とハイブリッド融合を用いた融合型量子計算は、表面符号の単位セルあたりわずか12回のハイブリッド融合で2.

title: Individually Addressed Logical Pauli Measurements by QLDPC Surgery on a Trapped Ion Quantum Computer
abstract: Quantum low-density parity check (QLDPC) codes may lead to order-of-magnitude reductions in the qubit overhead required for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Achieving this improved overhead requires logical operations that selectively address individual logical qubits encoded within multi-qubit code blocks. Recently proposed architectures achieve this through QLDPC surgery, in which non-destructive Pauli measurements are performed using ancillary ''gadget'' systems transiently entangled with the code block, generalising lattice surgery. Here we implement QLDPC surgery on a [[10,2,3]] generalised bicycle code using Quantinuum's H2-2 trapped ion processor. A single-round surgery measurement using seven gadget qubits measures the $\bar{X}_1$ operator with a 0.72 [0.32, 1.41]% (95% credible interval) error rate and agrees with subsequent transversal measurement with 1.03 [0.60, 1.65]% error. Decoding across three rounds of syndrome extraction suppresses the gadget measurement error, reducing the error rate to below 0.26%. The syndrome after surgery confirms return to the code space and the unaddressed ''spectator'' qubit is preserved with error 0.21 [0.04, 0.67]% during the three-round measurement. We further demonstrate composition of conjugate basis gadgets by sequentially measuring $\bar{X}_1$ then $\bar{Z}_2$, reusing the gadget qubits, and obtain a 1.12 [0.60, 1.94]% error in the $\bar{Z}_2$ measurement. These results constitute a hardware validation of the generalised surgery primitive underlying Pauli-based computing for QLDPC architectures.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates QLDPC surgery on a [[10,2,3]] generalised bicycle code using a trapped-ion quantum computer, achieving individually addressed logical Pauli measurements with error rates around 0.
summaries.zh: 该论文在囚禁离子量子计算机上利用[[10,2,3]]广义自行车码实现了QLDPC手术，完成了单独寻址的逻辑泡利测量，误差率约为0.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、トラップドイオン量子コンピュータ上で[[10,2,3]]一般化バイシクル符号に対するQLDPC手術を実装し、個別にアドレス指定された論理パウリ測定を約0.

title: Signatures of Narrowband and Ultrashort-Pulse-Like Probing in Coherent Anti-Stokes Raman Scattering Using Twin Beams and Sum-Frequency Generation Readout
abstract: We theoretically investigate coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) driven by bright twin beams with sum-frequency generation (SFG) readout. Expressing the SFG output in terms of quantum-field correlation functions yields multiple correlation structures with distinct properties associated with different interaction pathways on the bra and ket sides. Among them, frequency correlations between the CARS probe and SFG gating fields enable the two fields to act collectively as an effective narrowband probe, avoiding probe-induced spectral convolution. When this behavior appears on either the bra or ket side, the other retains Raman relaxation information as if probed by an ultrashort pulse.

summaries.en: The study theoretically shows that in coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering driven by bright twin beams with sum-frequency generation readout, frequency correlations between the CARS probe and SFG gating fields let them act collectively as an effective narrowband probe that avoids probe-induced spectral convolution, while the opposite bra or ket side retains Raman relaxation information as if probed by an ultrashort pulse.
summaries.zh: 该研究在理论上表明，在由明亮双光束驱动并采用和频产生读出的相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射中，CARS探测场与SFG门控场之间的频率关联使二者共同充当有效窄带探针，从而避免探针引起的光谱卷积，而另一侧（bra或ket）则保留如同被超短脉冲探测一样的拉曼弛豫信息。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、明るいツインビームで駆動され和周波発生読み出しを用いるコヒーレント反ストークスラマン散乱において、CARSプローブ場とSFGゲーティング場の間の周波数相関により両場が有効な狭帯域プローブとして協働しプローブ由来のスペクトル畳み込みを回避できる一方、bra側またはket側の他方は超短パルスでプローブされたかのようなラマン緩和情報を保持することを理論的に示した。

title: Force Sensing in a Recoverable Bosonic Quantum Memory
abstract: In continuous-variable quantum information, sensing and quantum error correction in the same mode face an intrinsic trade-off: sensors must accumulate weak external displacements, whereas bosonic codes typically suppress such shifts as errors. Here, we establish compatibility by constructing finite-energy bosonic codes that enable a single oscillator to sense an external force while actively protecting an unknown logical qubit. By encoding logical amplitudes across discrete wave-packet sites and capturing the force signal in a shared internal coordinate, we achieve an endpoint probe readout that is independent of the logical state under continuous photon loss $\gamma$. Crucially, binomial site recovery cancels packet-dependent probe distortions alongside logical errors: for a $(2r+2)$-packet code, memory infidelity is suppressed to $O(\gamma^{r+1})$ while residual memory-probe correlations scale as $O(\gamma^{r+2})$. Finally, superconducting quantum circuit benchmarks under competing photon-number dephasing and Kerr nonlinearity identify preferred encoding regimes for hardware implementation.

summaries.en: Finite-energy bosonic codes that encode logical amplitudes across discrete wave-packet sites and read out an external force via a shared internal coordinate enable a single oscillator to simultaneously sense a force and protect an unknown logical qubit, with binomial site recovery suppressing both logical errors and packet-dependent probe distortions so that memory infidelity scales as O(γ^{r+1}) and residual memory-probe correlations as O(γ^{r+2}) under continuous photon loss.
summaries.zh: 有限能量的玻色子码将逻辑振幅编码在离散波包站点上并通过共享的内部坐标读取外力，使单个振子能够同时感知外力并保护未知逻辑量子比特，二项式站点恢复同时抵消逻辑错误和依赖于波包的探测畸变，从而在连续光子损耗下使存储不保真度按O(γ^{r+1})被抑制、残余存储-探测关联按O(γ^{r+2})标度。
summaries.ja: 論理振幅を離散的な波束サイトに符号化し外力信号を共有内部座標で読み出す有限エネルギーのボソニック符号により、単一の振動子が外力を感知しつつ未知の論理量子ビットを保護でき、二項サイト回復が論理誤りと波束依存のプローブ歪みを同時に打ち消すことで、連続的光子損失の下で記憶の非忠実度がO(γ^{r+1})に抑えられ、残留する記憶-プローブ相関がO(γ^{r+2})でスケールする。

title: NAKO: A Benchmarking Framework for Evaluating and Diagnosing Neutral-Atom Quantum Compilers
abstract: Reconfigurable neutral-atom processors couple gate scheduling, atom placement, and parallel atom transport, so compiler decisions jointly determine physical execution costs. Evaluating these compilers requires attainable resource references and a way to trace excess costs to their causes. We present NAKO, a benchmarking framework that parameterizes circuits by qubit count, logical depth, and requested one- and two-qubit gate densities, and assigns attainable targets for Rydberg stages, routing intervals, and movement layers. Each benchmark is paired with an executable reference schedule; under the stated execution model, construction guarantees minimum Rydberg-stage and routing-interval counts, and minimum movement among schedules with the minimum Rydberg-stage count. Comparing compiler outputs with these references quantifies resource gaps, while reference mappings and intermediate physical states enable controlled interventions that trace excess costs to specific compiler decisions. In a 648-run evaluation of Enola and OLSQ-DPQA, NAKO identifies distinct bottlenecks. For Enola, placement scoring and cross-stage layout management contribute to excess movement; diagnosis-guided interventions reduce mean movement by 78.9% across five matched circuits. For OLSQ-DPQA, premature candidate selection and limited exploration of preparatory states produce avoidable entangling stages and routing intervals; four fixed-checkpoint continuations each eliminate one Rydberg stage and one routing interval without increasing movement. NAKO thus links resource targets backed by constructive optimality guarantees to controlled diagnosis and validation of compiler-specific resource savings.

summaries.en: NAKO is a benchmarking framework for neutral-atom quantum compilers that parameterizes circuits by qubit count, logical depth, and gate densities, pairs each benchmark with an executable reference schedule guaranteeing minimum Rydberg stages, routing intervals, and movement, and uses these references to diagnose how specific compiler decisions cause excess costs.
summaries.zh: NAKO是一个面向中性原子量子编译器的基准测试框架，它按量子比特数、逻辑深度以及单比特和双比特门密度对电路进行参数化，为每个基准配备可执行的参考调度以保证最少的Rydberg阶段、路由间隔和移动次数，并利用这些参考来诊断特定编译器决策如何导致额外开销。
summaries.ja: NAKOは、量子ビット数・論理深さ・ゲート密度で回路をパラメータ化し、各ベンチマークに最小のRydberg段数・ルーティング間隔・移動を保証する実行可能な参照スケジュールを付与することで、特定のコンパイラ決定が過剰コストを生む原因を診断する、中性原子量子コンパイラ向けのベンチマークフレームワークである。

title: Provably efficient experimental classification of quantum data with quantum kernels
abstract: Analyzing quantum systems is essential for quantum information processing, but can require exponentially many measurements without exploiting the structure of the system or task. Quantum machine learning offers a promising way to reduce this cost by learning from quantum data. Here, we theoretically establish a framework for efficient quantum-state classification and experimentally demonstrate the resulting scheme on a programmable photonic processor. Our analysis links learning efficiency to the structure of quantum data, without relying on a physical description tailored to each task. We derive sufficient conditions for accurate classification with a number of measurements polynomial in system size. We apply this guarantee to a resource problem in continuous-variable (CV) quantum computing: classifying stellar rank, a measure of non-Gaussianity. Experimentally, we implement the classification of single-mode CV quantum states with stellar rank zero and one. This is enabled by developing a programmable CV photonic processor capable of preparing and processing diverse Gaussian and non-Gaussian states and performing virtual projection onto such states, going beyond the Gaussian-only capabilities of most existing photonic platforms. The experiment demonstrates accurate classification despite experimental imperfections. Our results establish a theory-guided and experimentally validated framework for quantum-state classification that can be implemented on quantum devices available today.

summaries.en: The paper establishes a theoretically provable framework for efficient quantum-state classification using quantum kernels with measurement counts polynomial in system size, and experimentally demonstrates it on a programmable continuous-variable photonic processor by classifying the stellar rank of single-mode quantum states.
summaries.zh: 该论文建立了一个可证明高效量子态分类的理论框架，其所需测量次数随系统规模呈多项式增长，并在可编程连续变量光子处理器上通过分类单模量子态的恒星秩进行了实验验证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、系のサイズに対して多項式個の測定で効率的な量子状態分類を可能にする理論的枠組みを確立し、プログラマブルな連続変数光子プロセッサ上で単一モード量子状態のステラランクを分類することで実験的に実証した。

title: Error-Corrected Quantum Optimization via Rydberg Atom Array Embeddings
abstract: Rydberg atom quantum optimizers naturally encode the maximum independent set problem on geometric graphs. However, to solve general combinatorial optimization problems on more complex topologies, an embedding is required to overcome the limited-range native interactions. Such embeddings use gadgets, specific arrangements of atoms, which inevitably introduce ancillary atoms. Here, we show that this apparent overhead instead provides an intrinsic resource for error correction. Specifically, we demonstrate that the Parity Architecture-based Rydberg embedding naturally forms a classical error-correcting code, a principle that extends to other Rydberg blockade-based embeddings. Within superatom substructures, exact Rydberg-excitation-number constraints provide local error syndromes at no additional hardware cost and give rise to a strictly nonlinear code. To correct bit-flip errors, we introduce the precisely tailored Cluster decoder, which exploits these local constraints and the underlying gadget structure. Numerically, this approach achieves an error threshold of $p_{\text{th}}\gtrsim26 \%$ across different layout geometries. Experimentally, on the QuEra Aquila QPU, the Cluster decoder recovers exact optimization solutions with an average success rate of $\gtrsim8\%$ for systems of up to 107 atoms, even when bare hardware and standard greedy post-processing find none. A Rydberg atom array embedding is therefore not merely a hardware mapping of an optimization problem, but a co-designed architecture for quantum optimization in which embedding, computation, and error correction emerge from the same physical structure.

summaries.en: The paper shows that the ancillary atoms introduced by Parity-Architecture-based Rydberg atom array embeddings for solving general combinatorial optimization problems naturally form a classical nonlinear error-correcting code whose local syndromes enable a tailored Cluster decoder to achieve an error threshold above 26%, and that this approach experimentally recovers exact optimization solutions on the QuEra Aquila QPU for systems of up to 107 atoms where bare hardware and standard post-processing fail.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，用于求解一般组合优化问题的基于宇称架构的里德堡原子阵列嵌入所引入的辅助原子，会自然形成一种经典非线性纠错码，其局部错误症状使定制的Cluster解码器能够实现超过26%的错误阈值，并且在QuEra Aquila量子处理单元上对多达107个原子的系统进行实验时，即使裸硬件和标准后处理均告失败，该方法也能恢复精确的优化解。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、一般的な組合せ最適化問題を解くためのパリティアーキテクチャに基づくリュードベリ原子配列埋め込みが導入する補助原子が、局所的な誤りシンドロームを提供する古典的非線形誤り訂正符号を自然に形成し、専用に設計されたClusterデコーダによって26%を超える誤り閾値を達成できることを示すとともに、QuEra Aquila QPU上で最大107原子の系に対し、裸のハードウェアと標準的な後処理が失敗する場合でも厳密な最適化解を実験的に回復できることを示している。

title: Distributed Inner Product Estimation of Continuous-Variable Quantum States
abstract: Continuous-variable distributed inner product estimation (CV-DIPE) compares unknown states prepared by distant bosonic and quantum optical systems. It supports benchmarking without efficient classical descriptions or joint measurements. We develop three CV-DIPE protocols for the natural class of energy-constrained continuous-variable quantum states, based on coordinated displaced parity, coordinated Haar measurements, and independent homodyne shadows. For arbitrary multimode inputs in this class, including entangled and non-Gaussian states, we establish truncation error bounds and worst-case sample complexity guarantees for the exact inner product. The leading terms of these bounds favor coordinated Haar measurements, whose global implementation is experimentally challenging. The three protocols provide certified inner product estimates for distributed continuous-variable systems from local measurement data.

summaries.en: The paper develops three continuous-variable distributed inner product estimation protocols—coordinated displaced parity, coordinated Haar measurements, and independent homodyne shadows—that provide certified inner product estimates for energy-constrained multimode bosonic states, including entangled and non-Gaussian states, with truncation error bounds and worst-case sample complexity guarantees.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了三种连续变量分布式内积估计协议——协调位移宇称测量、协调Haar测量和独立零差阴影——为能量受限的多模玻色态（包括纠缠态和非高斯态）提供经认证的内积估计，并给出了截断误差界和最坏情况样本复杂度保证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、協調変位パリティ測定、協調ハール測定、独立ホモダインシャドウという3つの連続変数量子状態の分散内積推定プロトコルを開発し、エネルギー制約のある多モードボソン状態（もつれ状態や非ガウス状態を含む）に対して、打ち切り誤差の境界と最悪ケースのサンプル複雑度保証を備えた認定済みの内積推定を提供する。

title: Detuning-assisted cavity enhancement in spectroscopy
abstract: Cavity-enhanced spectroscopy is a widely used experimental technique. We show that detuning the cavity frequency from the transition of interest can enhance the precision for dipole moment estimation by up to two orders of magnitude beyond the improvement when the cavity is resonant with the transition. We show this for both classical continuous-wave (CW) and pulsed single-photon probes, even in the presence of losses. We trace this enhancement to a detuning-controlled redistribution of information between the light- and matter-like polaritons, with losses determining the optimal branch. We show that this enhancement remains accessible using conventional photodetection and time-correlated single-photon counting.

summaries.en: Detuning the cavity frequency from the transition of interest can enhance the precision of dipole moment estimation by up to two orders of magnitude beyond the resonant-cavity case, for both classical continuous-wave and pulsed single-photon probes even with losses, owing to detuning-controlled redistribution of information between light- and matter-like polaritons.
summaries.zh: 将腔频率从目标跃迁处失谐，可使偶极矩估计精度比腔共振时提高最多两个数量级，这一增强对经典连续波和脉冲单光子探针在有损耗时均成立，其来源是失谐对光型和物质型极化激元之间信息重分布的调控。
summaries.ja: 目的の遷移からキャビティ周波数を離調させることで、共鳴時と比べて双極子モーメント推定の精度を最大2桁向上でき、損失がある場合でも古典連続波およびパルス単一光子プローブの両方で有効であり、これは離調が光様および物質様ポラリトン間の情報再分布を制御することに由来する。

title: Quantum Computing through Computational Imaging: Representations, Measurement, and Inference
abstract: An algebraic correspondence between an imaging model and a quantum state does not specify a computational method: input access, measurement and decoding determine what can be returned. This exposition develops four distinctions for computational-imaging and engineering readers. It separates amplitude encodings of input values from encodings of complete candidate labelings, explaining why amplitude storage does not provide full-array readout. Complex-field interference motivates unknown-phase inference: complementary measurements resolve ambiguities that local Fisher information alone does not detect. Reshaping joint amplitudes into a matrix connects singular-value decomposition to pure-state entanglement, while distinguishing Schmidt rank from conditions for efficient classical simulation. In a four-pixel segmentation, an objective becomes a cost operator and a sampling circuit. One layer of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) lowers mean energy from $1.675$ to $0.686$ relative to uniform sampling, yet makes a nonoptimal labeling more probable than the optimum 0.484 versus 0.365. Archived IBM and IQM measurements illustrate a separate six-variable local boundary decision. Low-rank state reconstruction and selected quantum algorithms connect these distinctions to an end-to-end resource account. The derivations and reproducible numerical references assume complex linear algebra and probability, without prior quantum mechanics. The accompanying Seeing Amplitudes browser laboratory supports interactive exploration; the article remains self-contained and connects each representation to the estimate or decision it permits and the resources that output requires.

summaries.en: This exposition clarifies for computational-imaging and engineering readers how quantum representations, measurements, and inference determine what can actually be computed, illustrating with a four-pixel segmentation that one layer of QAOA lowers mean energy from 1.
summaries.zh: 这篇论述为计算成像和工程领域的读者阐明了量子表示、测量与推断如何决定实际可计算的内容，并以四像素分割为例说明，单层QAOA将平均能量从1.
summaries.ja: 本論考は、量子表現・測定・推論が実際に何を計算可能にするかを計算イメージングおよび工学の読者向けに明らかにし、4ピクセル分割の例で、QAOAの1層が一様サンプリングに比べて平均エネルギーを1.

title: Probing fluctuations in photon emission statistics of spin injected quantum dots with time dependent electronic excitation
abstract: Electrically spin-injected ensembles of InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots emit circularly polarized single photons, with the emission helicity determined by the spin polarization of the injected electrons. A ferromagnetic CoFeB spin-injection layer with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, combined with an MgO tunnel barrier, enables spin-polarized electron injection into the quantum-dot active region, resulting in circularly polarized photon emission at zero applied magnetic field. These devices realize direct spin-charge-photon conversion in an electrically driven, microelectronics-compatible quantum light source that operates without an external pump laser. Using an extended Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometer with four detectors and time-tagged readout, we measure time-resolved photon-number statistics that resolve up to $|2\rangle$ Fock states within a single excitation cycle. While single-photon ($n=|1\rangle$) emission tracks the electrical excitation pulse as expected, the two-photon ($n=|2\rangle$) statistics exhibit pronounced fluctuations at multiple temporal positions within the pulse. These fluctuations vanish upon demagnetization of the spin-injection layer, establishing a direct link between the multi-photon emission dynamics and the spin polarization of the injected carriers. The observations indicate that spin injection controls not only the helicity of the emitted photons but also higher-order temporal correlations of the emission. The behavior is phenomenologically captured by inserting both a variable excitation mechanism and a set of multi-emitter collapse operators within a stochastic wave function evolution. The platform thus opens a route to electrically driven, spin-controlled single and multi-photon Fock-state sources and provides a testbed for spin-conditioned multi-emitter dynamics in solid-state quantum light sources.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: Using a four-detector Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometer with time-tagged readout, the authors resolve up to two-photon Fock states within single excitation cycles of spin-injected InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots and show that two-photon emission statistics fluctuate in a way that vanishes upon demagnetization of the CoFeB spin-injection layer, linking multi-photon emission dynamics to carrier spin polarization.
summaries.zh: 作者利用带时间标记读出的四探测器Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉仪，在自旋注入的InGaAs/GaAs量子点单次激发周期内分辨出高达双光子Fock态，并发现双光子发射统计出现涨落，而这种涨落在CoFeB自旋注入层退磁后消失，从而将多光子发射动力学与载流子自旋极化联系起来。
summaries.ja: 著者らは時間タグ付き読み出しを備えた4検出器Hanbury Brown-Twiss干渉計を用いて、スピン注入されたInGaAs/GaAs量子ドットの単一励起サイクル内で最大2光子Fock状態を分解し、2光子放出統計が揺らぎを示す一方でその揺らぎがCoFeBスピン注入層の消磁後に消失することを明らかにし、多光子放出ダイナミクスとキャリアのスピン偏極との直接的関連を示した。

title: Left-Handed Transmission Lines for the Dynamical Casimir Effect
abstract: Left-handed (LH) superconducting transmission lines, built with series capacitors and shunt inductors instead of the series inductors and shunt capacitors of a conventional right-handed (RH) line, have a spectrum with a nonzero lower band edge and modes that become sparse at high frequencies. We study the dynamical Casimir effect in a LH line terminated by a flux-modulated SQUID and compare it with an RH line built from the same elements and with a long coplanar waveguide terminated by the same SQUID. We derive the quantum Hamiltonian and show that the coupling between two modes factorizes into their amplitudes at the SQUID. Together, the LH spectrum and the mode dependence of this coupling determine which modes are populated and how fast. With equal elements, the LH coupling grows with frequency and exceeds the RH one above a crossover pump frequency set by the cell inductance and capacitance, and only the LH line has resonances above the RH band edge. Pumping two modes at once lets a weakly coupled mode borrow coupling from a strongly coupled one, while crossings of resonance lines populate three or four modes without increasing the growth rate. Compared with the coplanar waveguide, the LH line has a similar coupling but keeps the created particles in the target mode, whereas the nearly equidistant waveguide spreads them over many pairs and needs more pump energy.

summaries.en: Left-handed superconducting transmission lines with flux-modulated SQUID terminations are studied for the dynamical Casimir effect, showing that their coupling grows with frequency, exceeds that of equivalent right-handed lines above a crossover pump frequency, and keeps created particles in the target mode better than a coplanar waveguide.
summaries.zh: 研究了以磁通调制SQUID端接的左手超导传输线中的动态卡西米尔效应，表明其耦合随频率增长，在高于由单元电感和电容决定的交叉泵浦频率时超过等效右手传输线，并且比共面波导更能将产生的粒子保持在目标模式中。
summaries.ja: 磁束変調SQUIDで終端した左手系超伝導伝送線路の動的カシミール効果を研究し、その結合は周波数とともに増大してセルインダクタンスとキャパシタンスで決まるクロスオーバーポンプ周波数以上で等価な右手系線路を上回り、コプレーナ導波路よりも生成粒子を目標モードにとどめることを示した。

title: Flow Matching for Fluctuation-Based Fluorescence Super-Resolution
abstract: Fluctuation-based super-resolution techniques are an appealing alternative to single-molecule and structured-illumination microscopy, as they adapt to standard acquisition settings and exploit the independent stochastic fluctuations of fluorophores across a sequence of frames. However, most existing approaches lack an explicit model of the acquisition process and provide only relative intensity estimates, limiting quantitative analyses. In this work, we combine model-based and generative approaches to exploit the full stochastic information in the sequence, proposing a reconstruction framework built on flow matching and a double-Poisson forward model accounting for blinking, blur, under-sampling and noise. The method alternates two steps: a flow matching model first learns the distribution of the acquired data; then, the sample and the background are jointly estimated by minimising a Kullback-Leibler divergence between observed and simulated distributions via regularised proximal gradient steps. On simulated and real Argolight data, the method resolves lines separated by 120 nm, outperforming SACD and eSRRF.
subjects: Image and Video Processing (eess.IV) ; Optimization and Control (math.OC)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a flow-matching-based reconstruction framework with a double-Poisson forward model that jointly estimates sample and background by minimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence, resolving 120 nm-separated lines and outperforming SACD and eSRRF on simulated and real Argolight data.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种基于流匹配的重建框架，结合双泊松前向模型，通过最小化观测分布与模拟分布之间的KL散度来联合估计样本和背景，在模拟和真实Argolight数据上可分辨间隔120纳米的线条，性能优于SACD和eSRRF。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、流れマッチングと二重ポアソン順モデルに基づく再構成フレームワークを提案し、観測分布とシミュレーション分布の間のKLダイバージェンスを最小化して試料と背景を同時推定することで、シミュレーションおよび実Argolightデータにおいて120 nm間隔の線を分解し、SACDとeSRRFを上回る性能を示した。

title: An Efficient SIM Beamforming Scheme Based on Physical-Empowered Projected Gradient
abstract: Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIMs) have emerged as a promising technology for next-generation wireless systems. Especially in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems, it has the potential to realize complicated wave-domain transformations with low hardware costs and energy consumption. However, SIM-assisted MIMO systems face two major challenges in channel estimation and beamforming. As the SIM elements do not have the signal processing capability, channel estimation can only be conducted in an indirect manner, which makes it challenging. Moreover, the precoding optimization after channel estimation is non-convex and also difficult. Targeting these issues, we exploit the time-division duplex (TDD) channel reciprocity to calculate the gradient backpropagation in an over-the-air manner. Based on this structure, we propose a gradient-based optimization framework that optimizes beamforming without explicitly estimating the SIM--UE channel. The proposed method, namely the physical projected gradient descent (P2GD) method, optimizes the achievable sum rate while incorporating zero-forcing (ZF) constraints. Based on the method of incorporating the ZF restriction, we propose two variations of P2GD, namely user equipment (UE)-P2GD and base station (BS)-P2GD. We also provide a theoretical convergence analysis and projected gradient techniques to ensure physical feasibility. Simulation results show that the proposed approach can achieve suboptimal beamforming in the multi-user system within a small number of over-the-air iterations, using a per-direction signaling budget below the pilot cost of explicit SIM--UE channel estimation. The proposed method provides a low-overhead beamforming scheme for SIM systems without explicit SIM--UE channel estimation.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a physical projected gradient descent (P2GD) beamforming framework for stacked intelligent metasurface (SIM)-assisted MIMO systems that exploits TDD channel reciprocity to compute gradient backpropagation over the air, thereby optimizing beamforming with zero-forcing constraints without explicitly estimating the SIM-UE channel.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种用于堆叠智能超表面（SIM）辅助MIMO系统的物理投影梯度下降（P2GD）波束成形框架，利用TDD信道互易性以空中方式计算梯度反向传播，从而在无需显式估计SIM与用户设备间信道的情况下，结合迫零约束优化波束成形。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、スタック型インテリジェントメタサーフェス（SIM）支援MIMOシステム向けに、TDDチャネル相反性を利用して勾配逆伝播を無線で計算することで、SIMとユーザ端末間のチャネルを明示的に推定せずにゼロフォーシング制約下でビームフォーミングを最適化する物理投影勾配降下（P2GD）フレームワークを提案する。
